description: E-422 (D-153, D-155; plans/rein-ecosystem-contract.md §2.6): the headless entry points rein-app calls (eight on 2026-11-10; `digest` added by E-429, D-159; `ledger` by E-432, D-159 addendum 2), with every subcommand and flag `rein help` documents for them on 2026-11-10. Flags may be added, never removed, inside a major version (the minor, before 1.0.0) — except by a ruling: `gate` and `ledger` left with the command gate (E-463, D-169 r2). A guard row (cli_test.sh, E-422.02) fails when one of these no longer appears in `rein help` on a line for its command.
